53	    match = re.match(constants.HUB_ARN_REGEX, arn)

72	                object, used for SageMaker interactions.
73	        """

75	        self.region = sagemaker_session.boto_region_name
76	        self._sagemaker_session = sagemaker_session

85	    def _fetch_hub_bucket_name(self) -> str:
86	        """Retrieves hub bucket name from Hub config if exists"""
87	        try:
88	            hub_response = self._sagemaker_session.describe_hub(hub_name=self.hub_name)
89	            hub_output_location = hub_response["S3StorageConfig"].get("S3OutputPath")
90	            if hub_output_location:
91	                location = create_s3_object_reference_from_uri(hub_output_location)
92	                return location.bucket

94	            JUMPSTART_LOGGER.warning(
95	                "There is not a Hub bucket associated with %s. Using %s",
96	                self.hub_name,

def get_info_from_hub_resource_arn(
    arn: str,
) -> HubArnExtractedInfo:
    """Extracts descriptive information from a Hub or HubContent Arn."""

    match = re.match(constants.HUB_CONTENT_ARN_REGEX, arn)
    if match:
        partition = match.group(1)
        hub_region = match.group(2)
        account_id = match.group(3)
        hub_name = match.group(4)
        hub_content_type = match.group(5)
        hub_content_name = match.group(6)
        hub_content_version = match.group(7)

        return HubArnExtractedInfo(
            partition=partition,
            region=hub_region,
            account_id=account_id,
            hub_name=hub_name,
            hub_content_type=hub_content_type,
            hub_content_name=hub_content_name,
            hub_content_version=hub_content_version,
        )

    match = re.match(constants.HUB_ARN_REGEX, arn)
    if match:
        partition = match.group(1)
        hub_region = match.group(2)
        account_id = match.group(3)
        hub_name = match.group(4)
        return HubArnExtractedInfo(
            partition=partition,
            region=hub_region,
            account_id=account_id,
            hub_name=hub_name,
        )

    return None


def construct_hub_arn_from_name(
    hub_name: str,
    region: Optional[str] = None,
    session: Optional[Session] = constants.DEFAULT_JUMPSTART_SAGEMAKER_SESSION,
) -> str:
    """Constructs a Hub arn from the Hub name using default Session values."""

    account_id = session.account_id()
    region = region or session.boto_region_name
    partition = aws_partition(region)

    return f"arn:{partition}:sagemaker:{region}:{account_id}:hub/{hub_name}"

def find_unsupported_flags_for_model_version(
    model_id: str, version: str, region: str, session: Session

    """Finds the model version specs unsupported flags for a JumpStart model version.

    flags_to_add = []

        model_id=model_id,
        version=version,
        region=region,
        scope=JumpStartScriptScope.INFERENCE,
        sagemaker_session=session,
    )

    if specs.deprecated:
        flags_to_add.append(CuratedHubUnsupportedFlag.DEPRECATED_VERSIONS)
    if specs.inference_vulnerable:
        flags_to_add.append(CuratedHubUnsupportedFlag.INFERENCE_VULNERABLE_VERSIONS)

    hub_name: str, hub_content_name: str, region: str, session: Session

    list_hub_content_versions_response = session.list_hub_content_versions(
        hub_name=hub_name,

    hub_content_versions: List[HubContentSummary] = summary_list_from_list_api_response(
        list_hub_content_versions_response

    unsupported_hub_content_versions_map: Dict[str, List[str]] = {}
    for hub_content_version_summary in hub_content_versions:
        jumpstart_model_id = next(
            (

                for keyword in hub_content_version_summary.hub_content_search_keywords or []
                if keyword.startswith(JUMPSTART_HUB_MODEL_ID_TAG_PREFIX)

                for keyword in hub_content_version_summary.hub_content_search_keywords or []
                if keyword.startswith(JUMPSTART_HUB_MODEL_VERSION_TAG_PREFIX)
            ),
            None,
        )

        if jumpstart_model_id and jumpstart_model_version:
            model_id = jumpstart_model_id[len(f"{JUMPSTART_HUB_MODEL_ID_TAG_PREFIX}:") :]

def get_info_from_hub_resource_arn(
    arn: str,
) -> HubArnExtractedInfo:
    """Extracts descriptive information from a Hub or HubContent Arn."""

    match = re.match(constants.HUB_CONTENT_ARN_REGEX, arn)
    if match:
        partition = match.group(1)
        hub_region = match.group(2)
        account_id = match.group(3)
        hub_name = match.group(4)
        hub_content_type = match.group(5)
        hub_content_name = match.group(6)
        hub_content_version = match.group(7)

        return HubArnExtractedInfo(
            partition=partition,
            region=hub_region,
            account_id=account_id,
            hub_name=hub_name,
            hub_content_type=hub_content_type,
            hub_content_name=hub_content_name,
            hub_content_version=hub_content_version,
        )

    match = re.match(constants.HUB_ARN_REGEX, arn)
    if match:
        partition = match.group(1)
        hub_region = match.group(2)
        account_id = match.group(3)
        hub_name = match.group(4)
        return HubArnExtractedInfo(
            partition=partition,
            region=hub_region,
            account_id=account_id,
            hub_name=hub_name,
        )

    return None
